```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(include = TRUE, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE)

library(here)

i_am("PWA.rproj")

source(here("r/Q/netCDF_add_dimension.R"))
```

```{r convert RDRS}

if(!file.exists(here("Data/Processed/runoff_wlat_ncdf4.nc"))){
  ncdf_add_dim(path_in = here("Data/Raw/PHyDAP2/PHyDAP_RDRS21_hourly_runoff.nc"),
               path_out = here("Data/Processed"), new_file_name = "/runoff_wlat_ncdf4",
               dim1_name = "time_hrs",
               dim2_name = "HYBAS_ID",
               var_name = "cropped_runoff",
               var_units = "mm/h")
  #              #basin_ids = c(7120966730, 7120966470)
}
```

```{r convert ERA5}
if(!file.exists(here("Data/Processed/era5_runoff_wlat.nc"))){
  ncdf_add_dim(path_in = here("Data/Raw/PHyDAP2/PHyDAP_era5_hourly_upland_runoff.nc"),
               path_out = here("Data/Processed/"), new_file_name = "/era5_runoff_wlat",
               dim1_name = "time_hrs",
               dim2_name = "HYBAS_ID",
               var_name = "upland_runoff",
               var_units = "mm/h")
               #basin_ids = c(7120966730, 7120966470)
}
```


To run the Raven routing model:

- Open the terminal

- Set the working directory to the folder containing the raven model files

- Enter the following command:
  
  - {Raven.exe file path (from root)} {model name}
